tier1.headline: Your Identity Biometrics Collected
tier1.quote: Remote Identity Verification (RIV), also known as Identity Proofing, is a method to verify and authenticate the identity of a person through government identification, biometrics, facial recognition, or other means of identity validation.

tier1.headline: Your Data Shared with DigiCert
tier1.quote: DigiCert enters into data processing agreements that require our sub-processors to process personal data only for the purpose of providing you the services you have requested, and not for their own marketing or sales initiatives.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: Global Privacy Notice - Provides a comprehensive overview of privacy practices at DigiCert and its affiliated brands.

tier2.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
tier2.quote: When DigiCert transfers personal data across country borders, we do so in compliance with applicable data protection laws and regulations.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Rights Limited
tier2.quote: You have certain rights with respect to your personal data.
